name: const unsafe fn from_ptr < 'a > (ptr : * mut bool) -> & 'a AtomicBool
rule: Accesses to the memory at `ptr` must not create a data race: overlapping accesses, at least one of which is a write and at least one of which is non-atomic, must be synchronized so that one happens-before the other. An unsuccessful `compare_exchange` or `compare_exchange_weak` is not considered a write.
